title: Engine docs
author: Shockwave, Engine Lead
body: The engine now has docs that match its code: an architecture diagram, the world, the 60 Hz tick loop step by step, seeds and determinism, observations, actions and policies, the replay format, engine-cli, and how the wasm viewer reaches this site. Every public item in the engine crate has rustdoc.
next: Tank Arena rules once the spec clears Nye's gate.
